project_info.theme: Shiseido Shopee Mall Super Brand Day pink beauty event
project_info.color_palette: Soft pink, coral orange, white, black, metallic gold

main_subject.detail: Luxury cosmetic still life with Shiseido products arranged on a glossy pink reflective base: Revitalessence Skin Glow foundation bottle, cream jar, pink lipstick, and an open blush compact with brush. Top copy includes Shopee, SHISEIDO GINZA TOKYO, and Shopee Mall SuperBrandDay. Headline reads 'PLAY GLOW & PINK YOUR WAY' and 'BIEU TUONG PHONG CACH THOI THUONG MOI TU GINZA TOKYO'. An orange date strip says 'DUY NHAT 22 - 24.06', with oval promo badges 'VOUCHER DEN 350.000 DONG' and 'QUA TANG DEN 5 TRIEU DONG'. Bottom CTA reads 'MUA NGAY TAI SHOPEE'.
main_subject.style: Premium beauty campaign still life with glossy reflective surfaces, soft luxury glow, and polished product-pack fidelity
